3: namespace Illuminate\Validation\Concerns;
4: 
5: use Closure;
6: use Illuminate\Support\Arr;
7: use Illuminate\Support\Str;

11: trait FormatsMessages
12: {
13:     use ReplacesAttributes;
14: 
15:     /**
16:      * Get the validation message for an attribute and rule.
17:      *
18:      * @param  string  $attribute
19:      * @param  string  $rule
20:      * @return string
21:      */
22:     protected function getMessage($attribute, $rule)
23:     {
24:         $attributeWithPlaceholders = $attribute;
25: 
26:         $attribute = $this->replacePlaceholderInString($attribute);
27: 
28:         $inlineMessage = $this->getInlineMessage($attribute, $rule);
29: 
30:         // First we will retrieve the custom message for the validation rule if one
31:         // exists. If a custom validation message is being used we'll return the
32:         // custom message, otherwise we'll keep searching for a valid message.
33:         if (! is_null($inlineMessage)) {
34:             return $inlineMessage;
35:         }
36: 
37:         $lowerRule = Str::snake($rule);
38: 
39:         $customKey = "validation.custom.{$attribute}.{$lowerRule}";
40: 
41:         $customMessage = $this->getCustomMessageFromTranslator(
42:             in_array($rule, $this->sizeRules)
43:                 ? [$customKey.".{$this->getAttributeType($attribute)}", $customKey]
44:                 : $customKey
45:         );
46: 
47:         // First we check for a custom defined validation message for the attribute
48:         // and rule. This allows the developer to specify specific messages for
49:         // only some attributes and rules that need to get specially formed.
50:         if ($customMessage !== $customKey) {
51:             return $customMessage;
52:         }
53: 
54:         // If the rule being validated is a "size" rule, we will need to gather the
55:         // specific error message for the type of attribute being validated such
56:         // as a number, file or string which all have different message types.
57:         elseif (in_array($rule, $this->sizeRules)) {
58:             return $this->getSizeMessage($attributeWithPlaceholders, $rule);
59:         }
60: 
61:         // Finally, if no developer specified messages have been set, and no other
62:         // special messages apply for this rule, we will just pull the default
63:         // messages out of the translator service for this validation rule.
64:         $key = "validation.{$lowerRule}";
65: 
66:         if ($key !== ($value = $this->translator->get($key))) {
67:             return $value;
68:         }
69: 
70:         return $this->getFromLocalArray(
71:             $attribute, $lowerRule, $this->fallbackMessages
72:         ) ?: $key;
73:     }
74: 
75:     /**
76:      * Get the proper inline error message for standard and size rules.
77:      *
78:      * @param  string  $attribute
79:      * @param  string  $rule
80:      * @return string|null
81:      */
82:     protected function getInlineMessage($attribute, $rule)
83:     {
84:         $inlineEntry = $this->getFromLocalArray($attribute, Str::snake($rule));
85: 
86:         return is_array($inlineEntry) && in_array($rule, $this->sizeRules)
87:                     ? $inlineEntry[$this->getAttributeType($attribute)]
88:                     : $inlineEntry;
89:     }
90: 
91:     /**
92:      * Get the inline message for a rule if it exists.
93:      *
94:      * @param  string  $attribute
95:      * @param  string  $lowerRule
96:      * @param  array|null  $source
97:      * @return string|null
98:      */
99:     protected function getFromLocalArray($attribute, $lowerRule, $source = null)
100:     {
101:         $source = $source ?: $this->customMessages;
102: 
103:         $keys = ["{$attribute}.{$lowerRule}", $lowerRule, $attribute];
104: 
105:         // First we will check for a custom message for an attribute specific rule
106:         // message for the fields, then we will check for a general custom line
107:         // that is not attribute specific. If we find either we'll return it.
108:         foreach ($keys as $key) {
109:             foreach (array_keys($source) as $sourceKey) {
110:                 if (str_contains($sourceKey, '*')) {
111:                     $pattern = str_replace('\*', '([^.]*)', preg_quote($sourceKey, '#'));
112: 
113:                     if (preg_match('#^'.$pattern.'\z#u', $key) === 1) {
114:                         $message = $source[$sourceKey];
115: 
116:                         if (is_array($message) && isset($message[$lowerRule])) {
117:                             return $message[$lowerRule];
118:                         }
119: 
120:                         return $message;
121:                     }
122: 
123:                     continue;
124:                 }
125: 
126:                 if (Str::is($sourceKey, $key)) {
127:                     $message = $source[$sourceKey];
128: 
129:                     if ($sourceKey === $attribute && is_array($message) && isset($message[$lowerRule])) {
130:                         return $message[$lowerRule];
131:                     }
132: 
133:                     return $message;
134:                 }
135:             }
136:         }
137:     }
138: 
139:     /**
140:      * Get the custom error message from the translator.
141:      *
142:      * @param  array|string  $keys
143:      * @return string
144:      */
145:     protected function getCustomMessageFromTranslator($keys)
146:     {
147:         foreach (Arr::wrap($keys) as $key) {
148:             if (($message = $this->translator->get($key)) !== $key) {
149:                 return $message;
150:             }
151: 
152:             // If an exact match was not found for the key, we will collapse all of these
153:             // messages and loop through them and try to find a wildcard match for the
154:             // given key. Otherwise, we will simply return the key's value back out.
155:             $shortKey = preg_replace(
156:                 '/^validation\.custom\./', '', $key
157:             );
158: 
159:             $message = $this->getWildcardCustomMessages(Arr::dot(
160:                 (array) $this->translator->get('validation.custom')
161:             ), $shortKey, $key);
162: 
163:             if ($message !== $key) {
164:                 return $message;
165:             }
166:         }
167: 
168:         return Arr::last(Arr::wrap($keys));
169:     }
170: 
171:     /**
172:      * Check the given messages for a wildcard key.
173:      *
174:      * @param  array  $messages
175:      * @param  string  $search
176:      * @param  string  $default
177:      * @return string
178:      */
179:     protected function getWildcardCustomMessages($messages, $search, $default)
180:     {
181:         foreach ($messages as $key => $message) {
182:             if ($search === $key || (Str::contains($key, ['*']) && Str::is($key, $search))) {
183:                 return $message;
184:             }
185:         }
186: 
187:         return $default;
188:     }
189: 
190:     /**
191:      * Get the proper error message for an attribute and size rule.
192:      *
193:      * @param  string  $attribute
194:      * @param  string  $rule
195:      * @return string
196:      */
197:     protected function getSizeMessage($attribute, $rule)
198:     {
199:         $lowerRule = Str::snake($rule);
200: 
201:         // There are three different types of size validations. The attribute may be
202:         // either a number, file, or string so we will check a few things to know
203:         // which type of value it is and return the correct line for that type.
204:         $type = $this->getAttributeType($attribute);
205: 
206:         $key = "validation.{$lowerRule}.{$type}";
207: 
208:         return $this->translator->get($key);
209:     }
210: 
211:     /**
212:      * Get the data type of the given attribute.
213:      *
214:      * @param  string  $attribute
215:      * @return string
216:      */
217:     protected function getAttributeType($attribute)
218:     {
219:         // We assume that the attributes present in the file array are files so that
220:         // means that if the attribute does not have a numeric rule and the files
221:         // list doesn't have it we'll just consider it a string by elimination.
222:         return match (true) {
223:             $this->hasRule($attribute, $this->numericRules) => 'numeric',
224:             $this->hasRule($attribute, ['Array']) => 'array',
225:             $this->getValue($attribute) instanceof UploadedFile,
226:             $this->getValue($attribute) instanceof File => 'file',
227:             default => 'string',
228:         };
229:     }
230: 
231:     /**
232:      * Replace all error message place-holders with actual values.
233:      *
234:      * @param  string  $message
235:      * @param  string  $attribute
236:      * @param  string  $rule
237:      * @param  array  $parameters
238:      * @return string
239:      */
240:     public function makeReplacements($message, $attribute, $rule, $parameters)
241:     {
242:         $message = $this->replaceAttributePlaceholder(
243:             $message, $this->getDisplayableAttribute($attribute)
244:         );
245: 
246:         $message = $this->replaceInputPlaceholder($message, $attribute);
247:         $message = $this->replaceIndexPlaceholder($message, $attribute);
248:         $message = $this->replacePositionPlaceholder($message, $attribute);
249: 
250:         if (isset($this->replacers[Str::snake($rule)])) {
251:             return $this->callReplacer($message, $attribute, Str::snake($rule), $parameters, $this);
252:         } elseif (method_exists($this, $replacer = "replace{$rule}")) {
253:             return $this->$replacer($message, $attribute, $rule, $parameters);
254:         }
255: 
256:         return $message;
257:     }
258: 
259:     /**
260:      * Get the displayable name of the attribute.
261:      *
262:      * @param  string  $attribute
263:      * @return string
264:      */
265:     public function getDisplayableAttribute($attribute)
266:     {
267:         $primaryAttribute = $this->getPrimaryAttribute($attribute);
268: 
269:         $expectedAttributes = $attribute != $primaryAttribute
270:                     ? [$attribute, $primaryAttribute] : [$attribute];
271: 
272:         foreach ($expectedAttributes as $name) {
273:             // The developer may dynamically specify the array of custom attributes on this
274:             // validator instance. If the attribute exists in this array it is used over
275:             // the other ways of pulling the attribute name for this given attributes.
276:             if ($inlineAttribute = $this->getAttributeFromLocalArray($name)) {
277:                 return $inlineAttribute;
278:             }
279: 
280:             // We allow for a developer to specify language lines for any attribute in this
281:             // application, which allows flexibility for displaying a unique displayable
282:             // version of the attribute name instead of the name used in an HTTP POST.
283:             if ($translatedAttribute = $this->getAttributeFromTranslations($name)) {
284:                 return $translatedAttribute;
285:             }
286:         }
287: 
288:         // When no language line has been specified for the attribute and it is also
289:         // an implicit attribute we will display the raw attribute's name and not
290:         // modify it with any of these replacements before we display the name.
291:         if (isset($this->implicitAttributes[$primaryAttribute])) {
292:             return ($formatter = $this->implicitAttributesFormatter)
293:                             ? $formatter($attribute)
294:                             : $attribute;
295:         }
296: 
297:         return str_replace('_', ' ', Str::snake($attribute));
298:     }
299: 
300:     /**
301:      * Get the given attribute from the attribute translations.
302:      *
303:      * @param  string  $name
304:      * @return string|null
305:      */
306:     protected function getAttributeFromTranslations($name)
307:     {
308:         $translator = $this->translator;
309:         $translationKey = 'validation.attributes';
310:         $attributes = $translator->get($translationKey);
311: 
312:         if (! is_array($attributes)) {
313:             $attributes = (array) $attributes;
314:         }
315: 
316:         $source = [];
317:         $deferred = [];
318: 
319:         foreach ($attributes as $attributeKey => $attributeValue) {
320:             if (is_array($attributeValue) && ! empty($attributeValue)) {
321:                 foreach ($attributeValue as $nestedKey => $nestedValue) {
322:                     $nestedPath = $attributeKey.'.'.$nestedKey;
323: 
324:                     if (is_array($nestedValue) && ! empty($nestedValue)) {
325:                         $deferred[] = [
326:                             'prefix' => $nestedPath.'.',
327:                             'items' => $nestedValue,
328:                         ];
329: 
330:                         continue;
331:                     }
332: 
333:                     $source[$nestedPath] = $nestedValue;
334:                 }
335: 
336:                 continue;
337:             }
338: 
339:             $source[$attributeKey] = $attributeValue;
340:         }
341: 
342:         while (! empty($deferred)) {
343:             $frame = array_pop($deferred);
344:             $prefix = $frame['prefix'];
345:             $items = $frame['items'];
346: 
347:             foreach ($items as $itemKey => $itemValue) {
348:                 $path = $prefix.$itemKey;
349: 
350:                 if (is_array($itemValue) && ! empty($itemValue)) {
351:                     $deferred[] = [
352:                         'prefix' => $path.'.',
353:                         'items' => $itemValue,
354:                     ];
355: 
356:                     continue;
357:                 }
358: 
359:                 $source[$path] = $itemValue;
360:             }
361:         }
362: 
363:         if ($source === []) {
364:             return null;
365:         }
366: 
367:         if (Arr::exists($source, $name)) {
368:             return $source[$name];
369:         }
370: 
371:         $sourceKeys = array_keys($source);
372: 
373:         foreach ($sourceKeys as $sourceKey) {
374:             if (! is_string($sourceKey)) {
375:                 continue;
376:             }
377: 
378:             if (! Str::contains($sourceKey, '*')) {
379:                 continue;
380:             }
381: 
382:             $quotedKey = preg_quote($sourceKey, '#');
383:             $wildcardPattern = str_replace('\*', '([^.]*)', $quotedKey);
384:             $delimitedPattern = '#^'.$wildcardPattern.'\z#u';
385: 
386:             if (preg_match($delimitedPattern, $name) === 1) {
387:                 return $source[$sourceKey];
388:             }
389:         }
390:     }
391: 
392:     /**
393:      * Get the custom name for an attribute if it exists in the given array.
394:      *
395:      * @param  string  $attribute
396:      * @param  array|null  $source
397:      * @return string|null
398:      */
399:     protected function getAttributeFromLocalArray($attribute, $source = null)
400:     {
401:         $source = $source ?: $this->customAttributes;
402: 
403:         if (isset($source[$attribute])) {
404:             return $source[$attribute];
405:         }
406: 
407:         foreach (array_keys($source) as $sourceKey) {
408:             if (str_contains($sourceKey, '*')) {
409:                 $pattern = str_replace('\*', '([^.]*)', preg_quote($sourceKey, '#'));
410: 
411:                 if (preg_match('#^'.$pattern.'\z#u', $attribute) === 1) {
412:                     return $source[$sourceKey];
413:                 }
414:             }
415:         }
416:     }
417: 
418:     /**
419:      * Replace the :attribute placeholder in the given message.
420:      *
421:      * @param  string  $message
422:      * @param  string  $value
423:      * @return string
424:      */
425:     protected function replaceAttributePlaceholder($message, $value)
426:     {
427:         return str_replace(
428:             [':attribute', ':ATTRIBUTE', ':Attribute'],
429:             [$value, Str::upper($value), Str::ucfirst($value)],
430:             $message
431:         );
432:     }
433: 
434:     /**
435:      * Replace the :index placeholder in the given message.
436:      *
437:      * @param  string  $message
438:      * @param  string  $attribute
439:      * @return string
440:      */
441:     protected function replaceIndexPlaceholder($message, $attribute)
442:     {
443:         return $this->replaceIndexOrPositionPlaceholder(
444:             $message, $attribute, 'index'
445:         );
446:     }
447: 
448:     /**
449:      * Replace the :position placeholder in the given message.
450:      *
451:      * @param  string  $message
452:      * @param  string  $attribute
453:      * @return string
454:      */
455:     protected function replacePositionPlaceholder($message, $attribute)
456:     {
457:         return $this->replaceIndexOrPositionPlaceholder(
458:             $message, $attribute, 'position', fn ($segment) => $segment + 1
459:         );
460:     }
461: 
462:     /**
463:      * Replace the :index or :position placeholder in the given message.
464:      *
465:      * @param  string  $message
466:      * @param  string  $attribute
467:      * @param  string  $placeholder
468:      * @param  \Closure|null  $modifier
469:      * @return string
470:      */
471:     protected function replaceIndexOrPositionPlaceholder($message, $attribute, $placeholder, ?Closure $modifier = null)
472:     {
473:         $segments = explode('.', $attribute);
474: 
475:         $modifier ??= fn ($value) => $value;
476: 
477:         $numericIndex = 1;
478: 
479:         foreach ($segments as $segment) {
480:             if (is_numeric($segment)) {
481:                 if ($numericIndex === 1) {
482:                     $message = str_ireplace(':'.$placeholder, $modifier((int) $segment), $message);
483:                 }
484: 
485:                 $message = str_ireplace(
486:                     ':'.$this->numberToIndexOrPositionWord($numericIndex).'-'.$placeholder,
487:                     $modifier((int) $segment),
488:                     $message
489:                 );
490: 
491:                 $numericIndex++;
492:             }
493:         }
494: 
495:         return $message;
496:     }
497: 
498:     /**
499:      * Get the word for a index or position segment.
500:      *
501:      * @param  int  $value
502:      * @return string
503:      */
504:     protected function numberToIndexOrPositionWord(int $value)
505:     {
506:         return [
507:             1 => 'first',
508:             2 => 'second',
509:             3 => 'third',
510:             4 => 'fourth',
511:             5 => 'fifth',
512:             6 => 'sixth',
513:             7 => 'seventh',
514:             8 => 'eighth',
515:             9 => 'ninth',
516:             10 => 'tenth',
517:         ][(int) $value] ?? 'other';
518:     }
519: 
520:     /**
521:      * Replace the :input placeholder in the given message.
522:      *
523:      * @param  string  $message
524:      * @param  string  $attribute
525:      * @return string
526:      */
527:     protected function replaceInputPlaceholder($message, $attribute)
528:     {
529:         $actualValue = $this->getValue($attribute);
530: 
531:         if (is_scalar($actualValue) || is_null($actualValue)) {
532:             $message = str_replace(':input', $this->getDisplayableValue($attribute, $actualValue), $message);
533:         }
534: 
535:         return $message;
536:     }
537: 
538:     /**
539:      * Get the displayable name of the value.
540:      *
541:      * @param  string  $attribute
542:      * @param  mixed  $value
543:      * @return string
544:      */
545:     public function getDisplayableValue($attribute, $value)
546:     {
547:         if (isset($this->customValues[$attribute][$value])) {
548:             return $this->customValues[$attribute][$value];
549:         }
550: 
551:         if (is_array($value)) {
552:             return 'array';
553:         }
554: 
555:         $key = "validation.values.{$attribute}.{$value}";
556: 
557:         if (($line = $this->translator->get($key)) !== $key) {
558:             return $line;
559:         }
560: 
561:         if (is_bool($value)) {
562:             return $value ? 'true' : 'false';
563:         }
564: 
565:         if (is_null($value)) {
566:             return 'empty';
567:         }
568: 
569:         return (string) $value;
570:     }
571: 
572:     /**
573:      * Transform an array of attributes to their displayable form.
574:      *
575:      * @param  array  $values
576:      * @return array
577:      */
578:     protected function getAttributeList(array $values)
579:     {
580:         $attributes = [];
581: 
582:         // For each attribute in the list we will simply get its displayable form as
583:         // this is convenient when replacing lists of parameters like some of the
584:         // replacement functions do when formatting out the validation message.
585:         foreach ($values as $key => $value) {
586:             $attributes[$key] = $this->getDisplayableAttribute($value);
587:         }
588: 
589:         return $attributes;
590:     }
591: 
592:     /**
593:      * Call a custom validator message replacer.
594:      *
595:      * @param  string  $message
596:      * @param  string  $attribute
597:      * @param  string  $rule
598:      * @param  array  $parameters
599:      * @param  \Illuminate\Validation\Validator  $validator
600:      * @return string|null
601:      */
602:     protected function callReplacer($message, $attribute, $rule, $parameters, $validator)
603:     {
604:         $callback = $this->replacers[$rule];
605: 
606:         if ($callback instanceof Closure) {
607:             return $callback(...func_get_args());
608:         } elseif (is_string($callback)) {
609:             return $this->callClassBasedReplacer($callback, $message, $attribute, $rule, $parameters, $validator);
610:         }
611:     }
612: 
613:     /**
614:      * Call a class based validator message replacer.
615:      *
616:      * @param  string  $callback
617:      * @param  string  $message
618:      * @param  string  $attribute
619:      * @param  string  $rule
620:      * @param  array  $parameters
621:      * @param  \Illuminate\Validation\Validator  $validator
622:      * @return string
623:      */
624:     protected function callClassBasedReplacer($callback, $message, $attribute, $rule, $parameters, $validator)
625:     {
626:         [$class, $method] = Str::parseCallback($callback, 'replace');
627: 
628:         return $this->container->make($class)->{$method}(...array_slice(func_get_args(), 1));
629:     }
630: }

<?php

namespace Illuminate\Validation\Concerns;

use Closure;
use Illuminate\Support\Arr;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\File\File;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\File\UploadedFile;

trait FormatsMessages
{
    use ReplacesAttributes;

    /**
     * Get the validation message for an attribute and rule.
     *
     * @param  string  $attribute
     * @param  string  $rule
     * @return string
     */
    protected function getMessage($attribute, $rule)
    {
        $attributeWithPlaceholders = $attribute;

        $attribute = $this->replacePlaceholderInString($attribute);

        $inlineMessage = $this->getInlineMessage($attribute, $rule);

        // First we will retrieve the custom message for the validation rule if one
        // exists. If a custom validation message is being used we'll return the
        // custom message, otherwise we'll keep searching for a valid message.
        if (! is_null($inlineMessage)) {
            return $inlineMessage;
        }

        $lowerRule = Str::snake($rule);

        $customKey = "validation.custom.{$attribute}.{$lowerRule}";

        $customMessage = $this->getCustomMessageFromTranslator(
            in_array($rule, $this->sizeRules)
                ? [$customKey.".{$this->getAttributeType($attribute)}", $customKey]
                : $customKey
        );

        // First we check for a custom defined validation message for the attribute
        // and rule. This allows the developer to specify specific messages for
        // only some attributes and rules that need to get specially formed.
        if ($customMessage !== $customKey) {
            return $customMessage;
        }

        // If the rule being validated is a "size" rule, we will need to gather the
        // specific error message for the type of attribute being validated such
        // as a number, file or string which all have different message types.
        elseif (in_array($rule, $this->sizeRules)) {
            return $this->getSizeMessage($attributeWithPlaceholders, $rule);
        }

        // Finally, if no developer specified messages have been set, and no other
        // special messages apply for this rule, we will just pull the default
        // messages out of the translator service for this validation rule.
        $key = "validation.{$lowerRule}";

        if ($key !== ($value = $this->translator->get($key))) {
            return $value;
        }

        return $this->getFromLocalArray(
            $attribute, $lowerRule, $this->fallbackMessages
        ) ?: $key;
    }

    /**
     * Get the proper inline error message for standard and size rules.
     *
     * @param  string  $attribute
     * @param  string  $rule
     * @return string|null
     */
    protected function getInlineMessage($attribute, $rule)
    {
        $inlineEntry = $this->getFromLocalArray($attribute, Str::snake($rule));

        return is_array($inlineEntry) && in_array($rule, $this->sizeRules)
                    ? $inlineEntry[$this->getAttributeType($attribute)]
                    : $inlineEntry;
    }

    /**
     * Get the inline message for a rule if it exists.
     *
     * @param  string  $attribute
     * @param  string  $lowerRule
     * @param  array|null  $source
     * @return string|null
     */
    protected function getFromLocalArray($attribute, $lowerRule, $source = null)
    {
        $source = $source ?: $this->customMessages;

        $keys = ["{$attribute}.{$lowerRule}", $lowerRule, $attribute];

        // First we will check for a custom message for an attribute specific rule
        // message for the fields, then we will check for a general custom line
        // that is not attribute specific. If we find either we'll return it.
        foreach ($keys as $key) {
            foreach (array_keys($source) as $sourceKey) {
                if (str_contains($sourceKey, '*')) {
                    $pattern = str_replace('\*', '([^.]*)', preg_quote($sourceKey, '#'));

                    if (preg_match('#^'.$pattern.'\z#u', $key) === 1) {
                        $message = $source[$sourceKey];

                        if (is_array($message) && isset($message[$lowerRule])) {
                            return $message[$lowerRule];
                        }

                        return $message;
                    }

                    continue;
                }

                if (Str::is($sourceKey, $key)) {
                    $message = $source[$sourceKey];

                    if ($sourceKey === $attribute && is_array($message) && isset($message[$lowerRule])) {
                        return $message[$lowerRule];
                    }

                    return $message;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get the custom error message from the translator.
     *
     * @param  array|string  $keys
     * @return string
     */
    protected function getCustomMessageFromTranslator($keys)
    {
        foreach (Arr::wrap($keys) as $key) {
            if (($message = $this->translator->get($key)) !== $key) {
                return $message;
            }

            // If an exact match was not found for the key, we will collapse all of these
            // messages and loop through them and try to find a wildcard match for the
            // given key. Otherwise, we will simply return the key's value back out.
            $shortKey = preg_replace(
                '/^validation\.custom\./', '', $key
            );

            $message = $this->getWildcardCustomMessages(Arr::dot(
                (array) $this->translator->get('validation.custom')
            ), $shortKey, $key);

            if ($message !== $key) {
                return $message;
            }
        }

        return Arr::last(Arr::wrap($keys));
    }

    /**
     * Check the given messages for a wildcard key.
     *
     * @param  array  $messages
     * @param  string  $search
     * @param  string  $default
     * @return string
     */
    protected function getWildcardCustomMessages($messages, $search, $default)
    {
        foreach ($messages as $key => $message) {
            if ($search === $key || (Str::contains($key, ['*']) && Str::is($key, $search))) {
                return $message;
            }
        }

        return $default;
    }

    /**
     * Get the proper error message for an attribute and size rule.
     *
     * @param  string  $attribute
     * @param  string  $rule
     * @return string
     */
    protected function getSizeMessage($attribute, $rule)
    {
        $lowerRule = Str::snake($rule);

        // There are three different types of size validations. The attribute may be
        // either a number, file, or string so we will check a few things to know
        // which type of value it is and return the correct line for that type.
        $type = $this->getAttributeType($attribute);

        $key = "validation.{$lowerRule}.{$type}";

        return $this->translator->get($key);
    }

    /**
     * Get the data type of the given attribute.
     *
     * @param  string  $attribute
     * @return string
     */
    protected function getAttributeType($attribute)
    {
        // We assume that the attributes present in the file array are files so that
        // means that if the attribute does not have a numeric rule and the files
        // list doesn't have it we'll just consider it a string by elimination.
        return match (true) {
            $this->hasRule($attribute, $this->numericRules) => 'numeric',
            $this->hasRule($attribute, ['Array']) => 'array',
            $this->getValue($attribute) instanceof UploadedFile,
            $this->getValue($attribute) instanceof File => 'file',
            default => 'string',
        };
    }

    /**
     * Replace all error message place-holders with actual values.
     *
     * @param  string  $message
     * @param  string  $attribute
     * @param  string  $rule
     * @param  array  $parameters
     * @return string
     */
    public function makeReplacements($message, $attribute, $rule, $parameters)
    {
        $message = $this->replaceAttributePlaceholder(
            $message, $this->getDisplayableAttribute($attribute)
        );

        $message = $this->replaceInputPlaceholder($message, $attribute);
        $message = $this->replaceIndexPlaceholder($message, $attribute);
        $message = $this->replacePositionPlaceholder($message, $attribute);

        if (isset($this->replacers[Str::snake($rule)])) {
            return $this->callReplacer($message, $attribute, Str::snake($rule), $parameters, $this);
        } elseif (method_exists($this, $replacer = "replace{$rule}")) {
            return $this->$replacer($message, $attribute, $rule, $parameters);
        }

        return $message;
    }

    /**
     * Get the displayable name of the attribute.
     *
     * @param  string  $attribute
     * @return string
     */
    public function getDisplayableAttribute($attribute)
    {
        $primaryAttribute = $this->getPrimaryAttribute($attribute);

        $expectedAttributes = $attribute != $primaryAttribute
                    ? [$attribute, $primaryAttribute] : [$attribute];

        foreach ($expectedAttributes as $name) {
            // The developer may dynamically specify the array of custom attributes on this
            // validator instance. If the attribute exists in this array it is used over
            // the other ways of pulling the attribute name for this given attributes.
            if ($inlineAttribute = $this->getAttributeFromLocalArray($name)) {
                return $inlineAttribute;
            }

            // We allow for a developer to specify language lines for any attribute in this
            // application, which allows flexibility for displaying a unique displayable
            // version of the attribute name instead of the name used in an HTTP POST.
            if ($translatedAttribute = $this->getAttributeFromTranslations($name)) {
                return $translatedAttribute;
            }
        }

        // When no language line has been specified for the attribute and it is also
        // an implicit attribute we will display the raw attribute's name and not
        // modify it with any of these replacements before we display the name.
        if (isset($this->implicitAttributes[$primaryAttribute])) {
            return ($formatter = $this->implicitAttributesFormatter)
                            ? $formatter($attribute)
                            : $attribute;
        }

        return str_replace('_', ' ', Str::snake($attribute));
    }

    /**
     * Get the given attribute from the attribute translations.
     *
     * @param  string  $name
     * @return string|null
     */
    protected function getAttributeFromTranslations($name)
    {
        $translator = $this->translator;
        $translationKey = 'validation.attributes';
        $attributes = $translator->get($translationKey);

        if (! is_array($attributes)) {
            $attributes = (array) $attributes;
        }

        $source = [];
        $deferred = [];

        foreach ($attributes as $attributeKey => $attributeValue) {
            if (is_array($attributeValue) && ! empty($attributeValue)) {
                foreach ($attributeValue as $nestedKey => $nestedValue) {
                    $nestedPath = $attributeKey.'.'.$nestedKey;

                    if (is_array($nestedValue) && ! empty($nestedValue)) {
                        $deferred[] = [
                            'prefix' => $nestedPath.'.',
                            'items' => $nestedValue,
                        ];

                        continue;
                    }

                    $source[$nestedPath] = $nestedValue;
                }

                continue;
            }

            $source[$attributeKey] = $attributeValue;
        }

        while (! empty($deferred)) {
            $frame = array_pop($deferred);
            $prefix = $frame['prefix'];
            $items = $frame['items'];

            foreach ($items as $itemKey => $itemValue) {
                $path = $prefix.$itemKey;

                if (is_array($itemValue) && ! empty($itemValue)) {
                    $deferred[] = [
                        'prefix' => $path.'.',
                        'items' => $itemValue,
                    ];

                    continue;
                }

                $source[$path] = $itemValue;
            }
        }

        if ($source === []) {
            return null;
        }

        if (Arr::exists($source, $name)) {
            return $source[$name];
        }

        $sourceKeys = array_keys($source);

        foreach ($sourceKeys as $sourceKey) {
            if (! is_string($sourceKey)) {
                continue;
            }

            if (! Str::contains($sourceKey, '*')) {
                continue;
            }

            $quotedKey = preg_quote($sourceKey, '#');
            $wildcardPattern = str_replace('\*', '([^.]*)', $quotedKey);
            $delimitedPattern = '#^'.$wildcardPattern.'\z#u';

            if (preg_match($delimitedPattern, $name) === 1) {
                return $source[$sourceKey];
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Get the custom name for an attribute if it exists in the given array.
     *
     * @param  string  $attribute
     * @param  array|null  $source
     * @return string|null
     */
    protected function getAttributeFromLocalArray($attribute, $source = null)
    {
        $source = $source ?: $this->customAttributes;

        if (isset($source[$attribute])) {
            return $source[$attribute];
        }

        foreach (array_keys($source) as $sourceKey) {
            if (str_contains($sourceKey, '*')) {
                $pattern = str_replace('\*', '([^.]*)', preg_quote($sourceKey, '#'));

                if (preg_match('#^'.$pattern.'\z#u', $attribute) === 1) {
                    return $source[$sourceKey];
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Replace the :attribute placeholder in the given message.
     *
     * @param  string  $message
     * @param  string  $value
     * @return string
     */
    protected function replaceAttributePlaceholder($message, $value)
    {
        return str_replace(
            [':attribute', ':ATTRIBUTE', ':Attribute'],
            [$value, Str::upper($value), Str::ucfirst($value)],
            $message
        );
    }

    /**
     * Replace the :index placeholder in the given message.
     *
     * @param  string  $message
     * @param  string  $attribute
     * @return string
     */
    protected function replaceIndexPlaceholder($message, $attribute)
    {
        return $this->replaceIndexOrPositionPlaceholder(
            $message, $attribute, 'index'
        );
    }

    /**
     * Replace the :position placeholder in the given message.
     *
     * @param  string  $message
     * @param  string  $attribute
     * @return string
     */
    protected function replacePositionPlaceholder($message, $attribute)
    {
        return $this->replaceIndexOrPositionPlaceholder(
            $message, $attribute, 'position', fn ($segment) => $segment + 1
        );
    }

    /**
     * Replace the :index or :position placeholder in the given message.
     *
     * @param  string  $message
     * @param  string  $attribute
     * @param  string  $placeholder
     * @param  \Closure|null  $modifier
     * @return string
     */
    protected function replaceIndexOrPositionPlaceholder($message, $attribute, $placeholder, ?Closure $modifier = null)
    {
        $segments = explode('.', $attribute);

        $modifier ??= fn ($value) => $value;

        $numericIndex = 1;

        foreach ($segments as $segment) {
            if (is_numeric($segment)) {
                if ($numericIndex === 1) {
                    $message = str_ireplace(':'.$placeholder, $modifier((int) $segment), $message);
                }

                $message = str_ireplace(
                    ':'.$this->numberToIndexOrPositionWord($numericIndex).'-'.$placeholder,
                    $modifier((int) $segment),
                    $message
                );

                $numericIndex++;
            }
        }

        return $message;
    }

    /**
     * Get the word for a index or position segment.
     *
     * @param  int  $value
     * @return string
     */
    protected function numberToIndexOrPositionWord(int $value)
    {
        return [
            1 => 'first',
            2 => 'second',
            3 => 'third',
            4 => 'fourth',
            5 => 'fifth',
            6 => 'sixth',
            7 => 'seventh',
            8 => 'eighth',
            9 => 'ninth',
            10 => 'tenth',
        ][(int) $value] ?? 'other';
    }

    /**
     * Replace the :input placeholder in the given message.
     *
     * @param  string  $message
     * @param  string  $attribute
     * @return string
     */
    protected function replaceInputPlaceholder($message, $attribute)
    {
        $actualValue = $this->getValue($attribute);

        if (is_scalar($actualValue) || is_null($actualValue)) {
            $message = str_replace(':input', $this->getDisplayableValue($attribute, $actualValue), $message);
        }

        return $message;
    }

    /**
     * Get the displayable name of the value.
     *
     * @param  string  $attribute
     * @param  mixed  $value
     * @return string
     */
    public function getDisplayableValue($attribute, $value)
    {
        if (isset($this->customValues[$attribute][$value])) {
            return $this->customValues[$attribute][$value];
        }

        if (is_array($value)) {
            return 'array';
        }

        $key = "validation.values.{$attribute}.{$value}";

        if (($line = $this->translator->get($key)) !== $key) {
            return $line;
        }

        if (is_bool($value)) {
            return $value ? 'true' : 'false';
        }

        if (is_null($value)) {
            return 'empty';
        }

        return (string) $value;
    }

    /**
     * Transform an array of attributes to their displayable form.
     *
     * @param  array  $values
     * @return array
     */
    protected function getAttributeList(array $values)
    {
        $attributes = [];

        // For each attribute in the list we will simply get its displayable form as
        // this is convenient when replacing lists of parameters like some of the
        // replacement functions do when formatting out the validation message.
        foreach ($values as $key => $value) {
            $attributes[$key] = $this->getDisplayableAttribute($value);
        }

        return $attributes;
    }

    /**
     * Call a custom validator message replacer.
     *
     * @param  string  $message
     * @param  string  $attribute
     * @param  string  $rule
     * @param  array  $parameters
     * @param  \Illuminate\Validation\Validator  $validator
     * @return string|null
     */
    protected function callReplacer($message, $attribute, $rule, $parameters, $validator)
    {
        $callback = $this->replacers[$rule];

        if ($callback instanceof Closure) {
            return $callback(...func_get_args());
        } elseif (is_string($callback)) {
            return $this->callClassBasedReplacer($callback, $message, $attribute, $rule, $parameters, $validator);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Call a class based validator message replacer.
     *
     * @param  string  $callback
     * @param  string  $message
     * @param  string  $attribute
     * @param  string  $rule
     * @param  array  $parameters
     * @param  \Illuminate\Validation\Validator  $validator
     * @return string
     */
    protected function callClassBasedReplacer($callback, $message, $attribute, $rule, $parameters, $validator)
    {
        [$class, $method] = Str::parseCallback($callback, 'replace');

        return $this->container->make($class)->{$method}(...array_slice(func_get_args(), 1));
    }
}

part.text:
Fixed `getAttributeFromTranslations()` to return `null` when `validation.attributes` is missing or empty instead of treating the untranslated key string as attribute data.

This prevents numeric rule parameters like `gt:0` from resolving to `"validation.attributes"`. All 817 validation tests pass.
